content.short: Build a virtual data centre in RollerCoin, a browser mining game, and earn real BTC, ETH, SOL and DOGE.
content.description: RollerCoin has run since 2018. Players play quick mini-games to earn hash power, buy and upgrade NFT miners, and join pools with others. The hash power they build up earns real cryptocurrency, paid out in more than ten tokens. It is free to start and runs in the browser, which has made it a common first step into crypto for many players. Players withdraw earnings in coins such as BTC, DOGE, SOL, POL, TRX and BNB, complete daily and weekly quests, and climb a public leaderboard. It reports more than 5.6 million players.
content.meta: Free browser mining game where mini-games and NFT miners earn real BTC, ETH and other coins. Explore RollerCoin on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
